decisions.what: Preserved the existing README intro paragraph and appended the new Docker Setup and Environment Variables sections
decisions.why: The spec was a modify operation, so keeping the prior project description avoids losing existing content while satisfying the new documentation requirements

decisions.what: Followed the Dockerfile spec's exact commands (npm install for development, npm ci for build, npm ci --only=production for production)
decisions.why: The per-file code change description is the authoritative instruction for what to generate; the generic rule guide is subordinate to it

decisions.what: Used ${VAR} interpolation in docker-compose.yml for all DB and app env vars sourced from .env
decisions.why: Matches the spec's 'from .env' wording and keeps a single source of truth without duplicating defaults in the compose file

decisions.what: Added an anonymous /app/node_modules volume on the backend service in addition to the .:/app bind mount
decisions.why: Prevents the host bind mount from shadowing the container-installed node_modules directory; the spec explicitly required both volumes
